title: 36 Hours on the Mendocino Coast
abstract: Once a collection of working-class logging, fishing and ranching communities, the city has become a stand-in for California’s left-coast eccentricities.

title: 36 Hours on the Mendocino Coast
abstract: What makes this stretch of small towns, hamlets and coastal ridges so alluring is its profound natural beauty and fierce independence.

title: 36 Hours in Bern
abstract: In Bern, you can dance till dawn or rise early and take a walk under the gaze of the Alps and be back in time for lunch.

title: 36 Hours in Bern, Switzerland
abstract: One of the most relaxed European capitals, Bern is also one of the most beautiful, with arcades and fountains framed by leafy hills.

abstract: With its rich cultural traditions and an architectural heritage that spans the centuries, Quito is more than just a stop on the way to the Galápagos.

title: 36 Hours in Perugia, Italy
abstract: Perugia, in the central Italian region of Umbria, is an enchanting hilltop city with a compact historic center that is a rambling maze of medieval streets.

title: 36 Hours in Perugia, Italy
abstract: Perugia is equidistant from Florence and Rome in the bucolic, central Italian region of Umbria.
